hero.alt: Athlete testing on a treadmill with a gas analysis mask, under a timber roof
hero.title: Your physiology, measured in the lab
hero.lead: VO2max, thresholds and running economy, measured in the lab in Chamonix or Paris, so you know your real training zones. For every level.

process.title: A test, step by step
process.lead: From booking to report, in Chamonix or Paris.

book.title: Book
book.text: Choose the test and the location, then buy it online. We confirm the slot by email.
book.parisText: The Rune gym, {{address}}. We rent a treadmill there for the test.
book.altChamonix: Performance Center test room in Chamonix: treadmill, screen and stone walls
book.altParis: The Rune gym in Paris: training floor, machines and treadmills

fitting.title: Welcome and mask fitting
fitting.text: A conversation about your health, your training and your goal sets the protocol. Then we fit the gas analysis mask and the heart rate monitor.
fitting.alt: A team member adjusts the straps of the gas analysis mask on an athlete's head

test.title: The treadmill test
test.text: The effort on the treadmill, plus lactate samples if you chose them. Depending on your sport, one of our two protocols:
test.alt: Athlete during a VO2max treadmill test, gas analysis mask connected to the analyser, Rune gym in Paris
test.caption: VO2max test in Paris, Rune gym

vo2.title: VO2max protocol
vo2.items: Maximum heart rate, VO2max, ventilatory thresholds 1 and 2, maximal aerobic speed, training zones, muscle oxygenation, core temperature, optional lactate.

runWalk.title: Run and walk protocol
runWalk.items: Running, walking and poles economy, critical walking gradient, critical running speed, VO2 and ventilation, heart rate, energy expenditure.

debrief.title: Your results, explained
debrief.text: At the end of the slot, a first reading with you while it is fresh. The full debrief follows by video call with a sport scientist from the team, once the data is analysed.
debrief.alt: A coach watches an athlete running hard on a treadmill with a gas analysis mask

report.title: The report, in the dashboard and as a PDF
report.text: Your ventilatory thresholds, VO₂max, maximal aerobic speed and three training zones, with recommendations for what comes next. The report downloads as a PDF, and two tests can be compared to measure your progress.
report.altPdf: First page of a VO2max test report as a PDF: VO2max, maximal aerobic speed, thresholds, profile and quick read
report.caption: PDF report and dashboard on a phone, fictitious data
report.altPhone: Test report in the Enduraw dashboard: VO2max, maximum heart rate, maximal aerobic speed and thresholds

offer.title: Tests and prices
offer.lead: Every test runs in Chamonix or Paris, except trail durability, in Chamonix only.

flat.name: Flat test
flat.short: Zones, VO2max, thresholds and running economy. Road, track, Hyrox, team sports, trail.

uphill.name: Uphill test
uphill.short: The same measures uphill, with your climbing speeds. Trail.

runwalk.name: Run and walk test
runwalk.short: Run or walk: the best option for each gradient. Trail.

durability.name: Durability test
durability.short: Your profile over a long effort at a fixed intensity. Trail, marathon, ultra.

premium.name: Premium trail profile
premium.short: The full trail runner profile on every gradient, our most complete test.

offer.business: Companies: tests in the lab or on site, group pricing from 5 people and a team summary for your HR and wellbeing leads.

place.title: The Performance Center
place.p1: A wood and stone chalet facing Mont Blanc, where the Enduraw team tests and follows its athletes.
place.p2: It also hosts camps, seminars, coworking and recordings, described below.
place.alt: Main living space of the Performance Center, stone pillars and wooden mezzanine
place.access: train station 150 m, bus 120 m, car park 250 m, Chamonix centre 15 minutes

camp.title: Training camp
camp.text: 4 to 7 days to train, get tested and recover, coached by the Enduraw team: tests, coached trail runs, physiotherapy and race strategy. All levels, limited places.
camp.subject: Training camp: registration request
camp.alt: Wooden terrace of the chalet at dusk, snowy Mont Blanc massif behind

seminar.title: Seminars
seminar.text: Up to 12 people, from half a day to several days, with a meeting room, 4K screen and meals on site. In the afternoon, a trail run or a physiology test led by our experts.
seminar.subject: Seminar at the Performance Center
seminar.alt: Presentation to a seated group in the chalet's main room

coworking.title: Coworking
coworking.text: A shared desk or a private office, by the day or for a stay, with meeting room, printer, showers and bar. The UTMB trails start at the foot of the chalet.
coworking.subject: Coworking at the Performance Center
coworking.alt: Workspace under the chalet's timber roof

podcast.title: Podcast studio
podcast.text: A room set up for recording, with microphones, cameras and LED lighting. For a podcast, an interview or brand content, on its own or during a stay at the centre.
podcast.subject: Podcast studio: booking request
podcast.alt: Podcast studio with camera, softboxes and recording table under the timber roof

cta.title: Book your test
cta.text: In Chamonix or Paris, we confirm the slot by email. A question first: write to us.
cta.subject: Question about testing
